narration.text: Next, the restrictions. A limited license can restrict driving to daylight, from a half hour before sunrise to a half hour after sunset. It can restrict driving to corrective non telescopic lenses. It can restrict driving to ordinary highways. It can restrict driving to automatic gears. It can restrict driving to dual mirror cars seeing two hundred feet back. And it can restrict driving to special control cars. So the list runs daylight, corrective lenses, ordinary highways, automatic gears, dual mirror cars and special control cars.

lines.text: Commercial and passenger licenses: tougher health bars.

narration.text: Here is a trap. Limited licenses add daylight, lens, highway, gear, mirror and equipment curbs for impaired drivers, while commercial and passenger licenses instead face tougher health bars. Health bars run higher for commercial licenses and for licenses covering taxis, delivery vans, buses and school buses. So the curbs belong to the limited license, and the higher health bars belong to commercial licenses and licenses for taxis, delivery vans, buses and school buses. Keep the two apart: curbs on one side, tougher health bars on the other.

Next, adaptive gear. Disabled residents who might drive with adaptive gear can seek state training. That training comes through the Bureau of Rehabilitation Services. A limited license can also restrict driving to special control cars. So for a disabled resident who might drive with adaptive gear, the place to seek state training is the Bureau of Rehabilitation Services, and the limited license list includes special control cars among its restrictions. Disabled residents who might drive with adaptive gear can seek state training through the Bureau of Rehabilitation Services.

lines.text: A limited license restricted to daylight.

narration.text: Here is a quick check: a driver holds a limited license restricted to daylight. When may this driver drive? Work it out before reading on. From a half hour before sunrise to a half hour after sunset. A limited license can restrict driving to daylight, from a half hour before sunrise to a half hour after sunset. The same kind of license can also restrict driving to corrective non telescopic lenses, ordinary highways, automatic gears, dual mirror cars seeing two hundred feet back, or special control cars. A limited license restricted to daylight allows driving from a half hour before sunrise to a half hour after sunset.

lines.text: Program for changed abilities and newcomers.
Higher health bars for commercial licenses.

narration.text: Let us review. The limited license program serves drivers whose abilities changed since licensing and newcomers who now qualify, on physician reports and possibly an inspector road skills test. Affected applicants should call Driver Services at least four months early. A limited license can restrict driving to daylight, corrective non telescopic lenses, ordinary highways, automatic gears, dual mirror cars or special control cars. Health bars run higher for commercial licenses and for licenses covering taxis, delivery vans, buses and school buses. Disabled residents who might drive with adaptive gear can seek state training through the Bureau of Rehabilitation Services.
